dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、今日から卒業パーティーの準備に入
　るけど、なるべく出席するんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"We're going to start preparing for the graduation party
today. Be sure that you show up."
dialogues.text:
"We're going to start preparing for the graduation party
today. Be sure that you show up."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はそう言うと、出席簿片手に教室を出て
行く。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei spoke and left the class with her attendance
book.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei spoke and left the class with her attendance
book.

dialogues.jp: 「卒業パーティーか……」
dialogues.en: "The graduation party, huh......?"
dialogues.text: "The graduation party, huh......?"

dialogues.jp:
まったく、うちの学園も祭り好きだよな……ク
リスマスパーティーなんてのもあったし。
dialogues.en:
People at this school love parties...... We had a Christmas
party too.
dialogues.text:
People at this school love parties...... We had a Christmas
party too.

dialogues.jp:
なにも卒業式の後に、パーティーなんてしなく
てもいいのにな。
dialogues.en: We don't have to have a party after graduation.
dialogues.text: We don't have to have a party after graduation.

dialogues.jp: （しかも、パーティーというより小さな学園祭）
dialogues.en:
(On top of that, it's not just a party. It's almost like a
festival.)
dialogues.text:
(On top of that, it's not just a party. It's almost like a
festival.)

dialogues.jp:
クラスや部活など一切関係なく、各人が好きな
催し物を企画できる。まさしくなんでもありの、
創作発表の場。
dialogues.en:
Anyone can participate with any entertainment. There are no
rules.
dialogues.text:
Anyone can participate with any entertainment. There are no
rules.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、催し物の企画に加わるかどうかは各人
の自由。なんの企画にも加わらず、純粋に客と
して参加することも出来る。
dialogues.en:
It's up to you whether you want to entertain or be
entertained as a part of the audience.
dialogues.text:
It's up to you whether you want to entertain or be
entertained as a part of the audience.

dialogues.jp:
こんな状況で進んで企画に参加するなんて、バ
カのすることだ。
dialogues.en: I think it's foolish to participate in entertaining people.
dialogues.text: I think it's foolish to participate in entertaining people.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「パーティーがどうした、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "What about the party, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What about the party, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: やる気満々の顔をしてバカの頭領がやって来る。
dialogues.en:
The head of the foolish bunch came towards me with a
motivated expression on his face.
dialogues.text:
The head of the foolish bunch came towards me with a
motivated expression on his face.

dialogues.jp: 「はりきってるな」
dialogues.en: "You look motivated."
dialogues.text: "You look motivated."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そう見えるか？」
dialogues.en: "Do I?"
dialogues.text: "Do I?"

dialogues.jp:
ニヤリと笑みを漏らすその表情は、誰が見ても、
腹黒さを感じるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Everyone could feel his evil-minded thoughts by looking at
his grin.
dialogues.text:
Everyone could feel his evil-minded thoughts by looking at
his grin.

dialogues.jp: 「また、何か｛・・／企画｝してるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What have you been cooking?"
dialogues.text: "What have you been cooking?"

dialogues.jp: いや、こいつがしてない訳ない。
dialogues.en: I know he's planning something.
dialogues.text: I know he's planning something.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フっ……付属最後を飾るに相応しいものを、
　現在進行中だ」
dialogues.en:
"Ha...... I have something suitable planned for our last
memory at this school."
dialogues.text:
"Ha...... I have something suitable planned for our last
memory at this school."

dialogues.jp: そうか、付属も遂に｛・・／最期｝を飾るのか……。
dialogues.en: For our last memory...... huh?
dialogues.text: For our last memory...... huh?

dialogues.jp: 「……捕まらんようにな」
dialogues.en: "......I hope you don't get arrested."
dialogues.text: "......I hope you don't get arrested."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「心配はいらん。脱出ルートは既に確保してあ
　るからな」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. I already have an escape route mapped out."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. I already have an escape route mapped out."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
どんなルートか知らんが、多分｛・・／ダメ｝だろう。
dialogues.en: I don't know what route it is, but it's probably no good.
dialogues.text: I don't know what route it is, but it's probably no good.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっと、そろそろ計画の第２段階に入らねば」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, it's time for me to move on to the second step of my
plan."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, it's time for me to move on to the second step of my
plan."

dialogues.jp: 教室を出て行く杉並を見送る。
dialogues.en: I saw him off as he left the classroom.
dialogues.text: I saw him off as he left the classroom.

dialogues.jp: ――さらば友よ。
dialogues.en: ......Goodbye, my friend.
dialogues.text: ......Goodbye, my friend.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……俺もそろそろ行くか」

俺は席を立ち、大きく伸びをすると、鞄を片手
に教室の出口へと向かった。
dialogues.en: "Well...... I should get going too."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I should get going too."

dialogues.jp: ◆今日から卒パの準備◆
dialogues.en: ◆Preparation for the graduation party◆
dialogues.text: ◆Preparation for the graduation party◆

dialogues.jp: 今日から卒パの準備期間に入るとの事だった。
dialogues.en: The preparation for the graduation party's starting today.
dialogues.text: The preparation for the graduation party's starting today.
